programme.title: Good Luck Molesting People?!; Collateral Damage!
programme.desc: A woman is accused of slamming her car door into a parked vehicle; a woman says a car salesman stole the $1,000 she left as collateral on a car.

programme.title: Reclaiming My Wig & Fraud-Tube
programme.desc: A woman is injured after her wig is repossessed; on-air talent outsources interviews for a web series to her assistant.

programme.title: Deadbeat Dadmate

programme.title: Roadrageous & Fried Catfish

programme.title: Chicken Little & Cruise Control
programme.desc: A dispute occurs between neighbors after chickens attack a dog and the dog fights back; a man sues because he was cut off on a party boat.

programme.title: Easter, Oblivious Easter Egg Hunters, and Kids in Slo-Mo
programme.desc: Children afraid of the Easter Bunny; egg hunts and birthday mishaps; a dog makes off with a mouthful of cash his owner just received.

programme.title: Workforce Follies, Bird Brains, and Party Games
programme.desc: A woman in a medical office is confronted by a hanging skeleton; a man deals with a bucket of stew that overturned in the trunk of his car; a safari park ostrich swallows a car air freshener; a grandmother has a virtual reality experience.

programme.title: Two Sides to Every Story

programme.title: DeLuLuLand

programme.title: Don't Be Shy in the Chi

programme.title: Second Chances in the Second City

programme.title: Stepping Into Your Chicago
programme.desc: The women are in power this week, and Tommy encourages them to invite the men into their world. Between roller skating, wine tasting and game shows, the ladies dig deeper and learn new qualities from the guys.

programme.title: What Black Men Say vs. What Black Women Hear with Iyanla Vanzant
